description: This file is a README documentation for the JavaScript implementation of the MurmurHash3 hashing algorithm, specifically for incremental hashing using the imurmurhash library. It describes usage, installation, and the API of the module.

classes.name: MurmurHash3
classes.description: A class representing the state of the incremental MurmurHash3 computation, providing methods to incrementally hash strings and retrieve the result.

methods.name: MurmurHash3
methods.description: Constructor for the MurmurHash3 class, initializes a new hash state possibly with an initial string or seed.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Incrementally adds a string to the hash state; supports chaining.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Returns the 32-bit positive integer hash result based on the data hashed so far.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the hash state for reuse, optionally with a new seed.
